Install OS security updates and runtime-only packages, excluding python3.12-venv, python3-pip-whl, compilers and build tools.
Copy only the completed virtual environment and service source from the builder stage.
Retain non-root execution, offline model settings and the existing runtime API and CUDA startup-smoke contract.
mandatory_local_gates: Final dpkg inventory has no python3-pip-whl or python3.12-venv.
Final virtual environment exposes no pip module or pip executable.
CTranslate2, faster-whisper, CUDA and cuDNN import/link smoke passes.

Repository tests, Terraform validation and generated-output checks pass.

rules: Use digest-pinned bases and multi-stage builds whenever dependency installation needs build or bootstrap tooling.
Keep compilers, package installers, venv bootstrap wheels, caches and source-control tools out of final runtime stages.
Run as a fixed non-root identity and support a read-only root filesystem.
Assert final OS and language-package inventories in behavioral tests.
Require local scanning and a separately authorized automatic ECR scan before deployment authorization.
Bind deployable child digests rather than tags or OCI indexes in Kubernetes.
